title: 第3章 玄极天第4章 凶煞筑体
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
嘉州古城，
因为有三江环绕，
常年灰雾弥漫，
山在江中，
佛在山中，
三江流域的生灵，心中有佛。
巨佛坐镇三江，
镇住一切妖魔鬼怪，
一切阴邪之物在幽暗中兴风作浪，
就会遭受巨佛的无边佛掌，
但这只是传说。
巨佛面向西方，
对岸便是古城墙围绕的嘉州古城，
古城青瓦木楼，最高不过五层，
夜晚，万家灯火倒映三江，
流光溢彩胜过天上的繁星。
不过，这里的天很昏暗，
经常乌云密布，一年难得有几个阳光灿烂的日子。
白天人声鼎沸，
比美姑繁华很多。

云阳很开心的从药铺出来，袖兜里面沉甸甸的；
‘没想到能挖到苕药，卖了五两水银，妹妹的甜果和花棉袄都有了，余下的钱还可以支撑家里一段时间，终于可以去拜师了。’
今天天公作美，阳光灿烂。
云阳买好花棉袄和一些家用后便快速往家赶，以他目前的脚力，回去也要披星戴月的走个五天。
半路上，
‘驾，驾···’
几匹黑马疾驰而过，
带起一路烟尘，
云阳的瞳孔快速聚焦，
因为不宽的泥土路，
有一老一小步履蹒跚走在前面十几丈，
云阳顿时飞奔过去，但，
还是晚了一步，
‘驾，驾，’
在云阳奋力扑倒老者时，
content_en:
Jiazhou ancient city,
Because it is surrounded by three rivers,
There is always gray fog,
The mountain is in the river,
Buddha is in the mountain,
The creatures in the Sanjiang Basin have Buddha in their hearts.
The giant Buddha sits in Sanjiang,
Conquer all demons and monsters,
All evil things are making waves in the darkness,
You will suffer from the boundless palms of the giant Buddha,
But this is just a legend.
The giant Buddha faces west,
On the opposite bank is the ancient city of Jiazhou surrounded by ancient city walls.
The blue-tiled wooden building in the ancient city only has five floors at its highest.
At night, the lights of thousands of houses reflect the three rivers.
The radiance is better than the stars in the sky.
However, it's very dark here,
There are often dark clouds, and there are only a few sunny days a year.
There was a lot of people during the day,
Much more prosperous than Meigu.
Yunyang came out of the medicine shop very happily, his sleeves were heavy;
‘I didn’t expect to be able to dig up sweet potato medicine. After selling it for five taels of mercury, my sister has sweet fruits and floral cotton-padded jackets. The remaining money can support the family for a while, and I can finally go to become a disciple. ’
Today the weather is beautiful and the sun is shining brightly.
After Yunyang bought a cotton-padded jacket and some household items, he hurried home. With his current foot strength, he would have to walk under the stars for five days.
Halfway through,
‘Drive, drive…’
Several black horses galloped past,
Bringing up all the smoke and dust,
Yunyang's pupils focused quickly,
Because of the narrow dirt road,
There was an old man and a young boy walking ten feet ahead, hobblingly.
Yunyang immediately ran over, but...
